title: plugin-view: the create/edit record Drawer is opened with direction right but DrawerContent is styled as a bottom sheet, so on desktop it renders as a half-width panel at the bottom left
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → Data → Records → *Add record* on any object renders the create form as a 672×526 bottom sheet anchored at the bottom-left of a 1440×900 window.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

The create-record form opens as a bottom sheet with a drag handle, clamped to the left half of the screen; the right half of the bottom area is an unshaded block. Measured geometry of the `[role=dialog]`: x=0, y=374, width=672, height=526, with `data-vaul-drawer-direction="right"`.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`renderDrawerForm` in `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` opens `<Drawer … direction="right">` and passes `className="w-full sm:max-w-2xl"` to `DrawerContent`. `DrawerContent` in `components/src/ui/drawer.tsx` hard-codes the bottom-sheet classes ("fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50 mt-24 … rounded-t-[10px]"), so the direction is ignored and `sm:max-w-2xl` pins it to the left.

## Expected

A right-hand drawer: full height, anchored to the right edge.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Let `DrawerContent` choose its classes from the drawer direction (right → `inset-y-0 right-0 h-full`, no top rounding), or render the form in a Sheet/Dialog on desktop. Any other `direction` caller gets the same fix.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *drawer direction right bottom sheet DrawerContent record form half width*: 3 hits (0 open, 3 closed).
